of well testing is largely concerned with identifying the determinants of the IPR 
i.e. the reservoir pressure, the zone permeability-thickness product and the skin 
factor.  Much of this chapter is concerned with measuring these parameters on a 
layer-by-layer basis.  For example the succeeding section deals with selective inflow 
performance, a technique which employs production logging passes to determine 
layer pressures and PIs.  However the well operating point is controlled by the 
intersection of the IPR with the vertical lift performance (VLP) curve, as shown in 
Figure 22, and it is just as important to identify the parameters which control the 
nature of the VLP relation.  In the case of the formation, well testing in the reservoir 
monitoring mode is tracking changes in formation pressure and skin factor and
